title: Authenticated vector generators sign a hidden non-wire byte
description: link_frame.json defines the signed preimage as the exact encoded frame through payload excluding only MIC, but generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py and generate_packets_timing.py insert an extra 0x00 after SeqNum before signing. Verification found 0/11 DIO and 0/16 timing signatures validate over wire-minus-MIC; all validate only with the hidden byte. Define one normative link-signature preimage, remove the hidden byte, regenerate affected vectors independently, and add cross-vector verification over exact wire bytes.
notes: Design correction after reviewing normative draft-lichen-link-01.md Section 4.4 and commit 3f40a156c9: DST_LEN(1) is intentional domain separation and production Python/Rust agree. Fix the stale link_frame.json preimages/signatures and spec/02, not the authenticated generators' 0x00 for AddrMode.NONE. Include SIID(8) iff its flag is set.
